text:
Nina (PM): quick thread to lock down DP recruitment priors and promotion gates. trying to avoid rehashing in meetings.
Cal (Eng): sounds good. ops prefers fewer high-touch partners.
Jo (ProdOps): propose cap: 7 active DPs, max 3 high-touch. reserve 1 slot for rapid follow-up.
Ruth (Research): scoring should prefer partners that will run structured evals and share recordings. gives us signal density.
Sam (Design): want coverage across use-cases. target at least 3 verticals per quarter and one small startup (team <10).
Nina (PM): draft scoring weights: engagement 30%, strategic impact 25%, domain match 20%, eval depth 15%, compliance risk 10%.
Cal (Eng): compliance should route to private-deploy track if needed; don't auto-reject. also capture latency SLO and session length in intake.
Ruth (Research): simple sheet formula we can use:
score = 0.3*engage + 0.25*strategic + 0.2*domain + 0.15*eval + 0.1*(1 - risk)
Sam (Design): add a soft "infra-value" flag for partners exercising vector DBs, streaming, or tool calls. tie-breaker only.
Jo (ProdOps): intake must include: eval cadence, avg prompt length, concurrency, p95 latency target, sensitive_data boolean. I'll add automated reminders.
dp-bot: scheduled: will ping 48h before mid-wave and final reviews. :robot_face:
Nina (PM): promotion criteria DP->beta: >=75% participation, no unresolved infra blockers, and measurable improvement on at least one partner metric (latency/cost/accuracy).
Cal (Eng): agree. add expected traffic and ops contact in intake so we can size infra.
Ruth (Research): action: I'll build a scoring sheet template with examples.
Sam (Design): action: I'll map vertical coverage and small-team targets.
Jo (ProdOps): action: updating intake form and automations now; will post link.
Nina (PM): I'll collate and publish a 1-page playbook by EOD tomorrow. aiming for a shortlist next Tue.
